title: Lightweight, Very, Very Lightweight
text: Lightweight, Very, Very Lightweight. This is about what you would expect for the money. It is very lightweight in contruction and in vacuum power. This would be OK for someone in a small apartment with no kids, pets or real people living there. The cord is pretty short. The thing that holds the attachments is poorly placed. All in all I wouldn't recommend it and it isn't going to make me forget about my 20 year old Eureka.

product_metadata.title: Dirt Devil 082660 Vision Canister Vacuum
features: Bagless canister vacuum great for homes with a variety of surfaces and pets
12 amp motor; HEPA filter traps 99.9 percent of dust and allergens
31-inch telescoping metal wand extends to 42-1/2 inches; 15-foot cord with auto rewind
Tools include upholstery tool, crevice tool dusting brush, turbo power hand brush (great for pet hair), and carpet nozzle
Weighs 10.9 pounds; backed by 2 year warranty (parts and motor)
description: Dirt Devil's new Vision Canister Vacuum is the perfect choice for homes with multiple types of flooring surfaces. Lightweight and bagless, the Vision features a powerful 12 amp motor and HEPA filtration. Whether it's picking up dirt or pet hair on your hard floors, or cleaning upholstery with the turbo floor tool, the Vision's 15 foot automatic cord rewind and non-marring wheels make maneuvering around your home effortless. The Vision features a 6' stretch hose; on-board tools; one touch dirt cup release and a two year worry free warranty.
